votes.motion: Close the public hearing and adopt an ordinance establishing the final rate of tax levy, including the final levy for the Library Fund, upon all real and personal property within Salt Lake City, made taxable by law for fiscal year 2022-2023 and ratify the budget as adopted by the Council in June
votes.description: Continuation of the FY2022-23 Truth-in-Taxation public hearing (opened August 16, 2022). After public comment, the Council closed the hearing and adopted the ordinance setting the final rate of tax levy, including the Library Fund levy, above the certified tax rate, and ratified the budget adopted by the Council in June.
